title: OpenAI reportedly to buy about $300B of Oracle cloud computing over five years

sources.quote: OpenAI signed a $300 billion contract with Oracle to purchase cloud computing capacity over five years, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
OpenAI has committed to a $300bn cloud computing contract with Oracle, expected to last nearly five years, according to a report by the Wall Street Journal citing undisclosed sources.

Our MultiCloud database revenue continues to grow at over 100%, and we signed multiple large cloud services agreements including one that is expected to contribute more than $30 billion in annual revenue starting in FY28.
Multiple news outlets have confirmed that the eye-popping, $30 billion-a-year contract that Oracle revealed earlier this week is with artificial intelligence company OpenAI.

explain: OpenAI is renting about 4.5 gigawatts of data-center computing from Oracle as part of its Stargate build-out. Oracle disclosed an unnamed $30B-a-year contract in June 2025 that reporters tied to OpenAI; the Wall Street Journal put the total at about $300B over roughly five years starting in 2027. Neither company has confirmed the total.
